candidates.snippet: Read the full assessment on the ENDF’s counteroffensive and other developments in the Ethiopia war from this past week's Africa File here: https://t.co/AN0TQtCjjX

BREAKING | Ethiopian federal forces captured Mekele, the Tigray regional capital, on October 3.

The Ethiopian military (ENDF) and allied Tigray Peace Force advanced from the east to recapture Mekele airport, which is on the outskirts of Mekele, before entering the city.
